script:
Zheng Youhao
Your name is Zheng Youhao. You're an introverted child. Your father's death from illness, your younger brother's early death, and your family's poverty caused you to develop mild depression. Your mother raised you alone, and to repay her, you decided to pull yourself together. Through your own efforts, you finally got into the decent Qingbei High School.
This was an elite high school where most classmates came from prominent backgrounds and wealthy families, making you feel very lonely. In your first year, you were used to being alone until Qin Laoda appeared.
Qin Laoda was a famous figure at this high school, not because of himself but because he had a musician father. You only knew his father held an unshakeable position in the music world, but didn't know much about this person, same with Qin Laoda.
On September 1, 2016, class division put you and Qin Laoda in the same Grade 11 Class 7. This person had terrible grades but was generous with people, always followed by two lackey-like people. Although you were in the same class, you didn't dare approach such a figure easily. At the same time, a girl named Jia Meili in class caught your attention. She was an art student, beautiful and elegant. You fell in love at first sight but didn't dare express it, only knowing she had a good relationship with classmate Zhuang Qingchun.
Your excellent grades and introverted personality made another small clique in class dislike you, planning to corner you after school and teach you a lesson.
On the evening of October 26, 2016, after evening study session, you rode your bike home as usual. Passing a certain alley entrance, you were knocked down by someone on an electric scooter, and three or four people dragged you away. When that group was about to beat you up, Qin Laoda and his group happened to appear, and he demanded they let you go.
Qin Laoda had extremely high prestige at school - almost no one dared oppose him. So obviously, you were spared from disaster. Although you didn't know why Qin Laoda saved you, you were still very grateful. For the first time at this school, you felt cared for.
From then on, you and Qin Laoda became friends. That night's group, pressured by Qin Laoda, never bothered you again, increasing your good feelings toward him. Qin Laoda's two lackeys treated you decently too, especially the one called Wei Xiaodi, who always unconsciously spoke up for you. You felt you could integrate into this small group, turning the trio into a quartet.
After that, helping Qin Laoda with homework, buying breakfast, and running errands became routine. In serious cases, you'd even take the blame for Qin Laoda, suffering quite a bit. But since mixing with Qin Laoda, others treated you with much more respect, making you start to feel inflated - these sufferings didn't matter anymore.
During a break in evening study session in March 2018, Qin Laoda called you as usual to buy late-night snacks for everyone. You said: "I need to go to the office to submit homework. Could you guys help me buy snacks this time?"
Qin Laoda was obviously stunned and laughed: "I'm about to go to the toilet to take a shit. Want me to bring it back for you to eat?" After saying this, he and one lackey laughed heartily, while Wei Xiaodi said nothing.
Though prepared for rejection, this response still made you feel very insulted. You remembered recently hearing people discussing you in the men's restroom, saying you were Qin Laoda's running dog, groveling and flattering daily without dignity. Now being so publicly humiliated by Qin Laoda and his group, your inner resentment grew deeper, but you couldn't act on it - you could only clench your fists.
April 5, 2018 was Tomb Sweeping Day. You and your mother went to pay respects to your father and brother as usual. Your father died when you were three from a hereditary family disease, but you didn't know the cause of your brother's death. Your mother was always evasive about this, sometimes saying the premature baby was too weak to survive, sometimes saying he got the same hereditary disease as dad.
That evening, your mother went out. You needed to get something from her room but accidentally discovered a drawer that was usually locked was unlocked today. Curiosity made you open the drawer, and you saw a notebook you'd never seen before.
Opening the notebook, you felt like you were in a huge ice cellar - every word made you shudder. This was your mother's diary, recording events from 2005 to 2006.
In 2005, famous musician Qin Zhuanjia took a fancy to your elegant, beautiful mother, wanting her as his mistress. When mother refused, Qin Zhuanjia raped her. Nearly four months later, she discovered she was pregnant but couldn't have an abortion due to risk of massive bleeding. In 2006, mother gave birth to a son. Shortly after leaving confinement, the brother was murdered by Qin Zhuanjia. That Qin Zhuanjia who committed every evil for his reputation was Qin Laoda's father.
The hatred accumulated in your heart completely exploded. You decided to avenge your brother and mother, and fight for yourself. Since you couldn't kill Qin Zhuanjia, you'd kill Qin Laoda to let Qin Zhuanjia taste losing a loved one.
In mid-May 2018, you accidentally heard Qin Laoda telling someone "lately Jia Meili has been seducing me persistently." Afraid and having hesitated for so long, you finally decided to carry out your revenge plan - eliminate Qin Laoda then tell Jia Meili your feelings.
[June 1, 2018]
June 1, 2018 was the last Friday before the college entrance exam. All graduating students would go home to rest and prepare for the exam after this day. That evening, your Grade 12 Class 7 classmates would have a farewell dinner at a restaurant near school. You knew Qin Laoda would definitely return to the dormitory to get luggage before going home, so you planned to drug him at the dinner, creating the illusion he was drunk, then kill him in the dormitory.
19:00, the farewell dinner began on time. During the meal, Jia Meili was particularly attentive to Qin Laoda and even toasted him. Though you felt annoyed, you used this atmosphere to slip the prepared drug into Qin Laoda's drink.
21:00, everyone finished eating and prepared to go home. You noticed Qin Laoda seemed a bit listless - everyone thought he was drunk, but you knew the drug was taking effect. Qin Laoda said he needed to return to the dormitory to get some luggage. You were about to say you'd go with him when Wei Xiaodi beat you to it. You felt you couldn't act with Qin Laoda and Wei Xiaodi together, so you planned to follow them first and wait until Qin Laoda was alone. So you told everyone you were going home first and left the restaurant right after Qin and Wei.
21:15, you saw Qin and Wei enter the dormitory building and hid behind a large tree downstairs, observing the dormitory entrance. As night fell and most students had gone home, there weren't many people coming and going.
21:20, you saw Wei Xiaodi come out of the dormitory with luggage and slowly walk away. Feeling the time was right, you immediately entered the dormitory building and headed toward Qin Laoda's dormitory.
21:22, you pushed open Qin Laoda's dormitory door and found him lying in a pool of blood, already dead. You actually felt a bit disappointed - you hadn't even acted yet, and he was already dead. On second thought, you felt that even if he was dead, he couldn't die so easily. So you took out your Swiss Army knife and stabbed his corpse repeatedly until you felt satisfied.
21:28, you left Qin Laoda's dormitory and headed to Jia Meili's dormitory.
21:31, you arrived outside Jia Meili's dormitory and found the hallway light was broken, but didn't mind. After knocking for a long time with no one answering, thinking she wasn't in the dormitory, you disappointedly left.
21:35, you walked out of the dormitory building and left school, throwing away the Swiss Army knife on the road.
22:30, having returned home, you received a police summons.
acts_goal: Hide the matter about your mother and younger brother
